name: EcoLog: Your Pocket AI Field Guide
tagline: Photograph plants and insects and get illustrated field-guide entries for your own nature log.

awards: Hack the 6ix x TKS: Best Beginner Hack

problem: People notice species on walks but have no easy way to identify and remember them.
solution: Identifies organisms from photos with AI and generates illustrated field-guide pages in a personal log.
demo_moment: Team-described: snap a flower and get a field-guide page about it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Hack the 6ix x TKS: Best Beginner Hack” among 131 submissions.
A beginner team built a complete, charming flow.

lessons: Beginner prizes reward a small, delightful, finished idea.
